answer: Since the throttle counters live in the island ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 66 keys as a result pays for 66 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the ocean quota and the nadir admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 8 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
